summary.text: Adam Bair is a Democratic candidate for South Dakota House of Representatives District 10, a two-seat district with no incumbent, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Adam Bair earned a high school diploma from Skyline High School and lists consulting as his career experience.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he worked a full-time job, a part-time job and drove for Lyft for several years while barely getting by.
He listed living affordably, labor and education as his key campaign messages, including fair wages, safe working conditions, the right to organize, and keeping public funds in public schools.
He named affordability, labor rights, education, conservation, health care and economic development as policy areas he is passionate about.
